column5: Rejects non-object JSON, unknown fields, and missing required fields.
Rejects nil requests, malformed multipart bodies, and unsupported upload request shapes.
Fuzzes malformed OpenAPI request and response bodies while preserving valid HTTP and Problem Details response boundaries.
Missing API key header returns 401; malformed or conflicting auth headers return 400.
Missing webhook signature is rejected before payload trust.
Body-bearing JSON routes reject invalid content types with Problem Details.
Body-bearing JSON write requests reject missing content type with Problem Details.
Multipart decoder rejects non-multipart upload content types.
Invalid API key fails closed without running the protected handler.
Rejects wrong issuer, wrong audience, expired token, not-yet-valid token, missing subject, and key miss.
Rejects mismatched tenant header and authenticated tenant context.
Rejects same replay key across different tenant scopes without running the handler.
Oversized request body read fails through MaxBytesReader and returns 413 in the handler.
Multipart request exceeding MaxRequestBytes is rejected before parsing trust.
Oversized webhook payload returns 413 Problem Details.
Rejects long query keys, long values, invalid limits, zero limits, and limits above maximum.
Stable list endpoint parser returns field errors for invalid pagination input.
